name: Feature Request
description: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Drex Agent Firewall
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: problem
    attributes:
      label: Problem Description
      description: Is your feature request related to a specific agent framework or tool adapter?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: solution
    attributes:
      label: Proposed Solution
      description: Describe the solution or adapter design.
    validations:
      required: true
